headline: Bitcoin Slumps on Risk Asset Deleveraging and Renewed US Rate Concerns
summary: Bitcoin prices retreated as institutional funds reduced exposure to risk assets following a Wall Street equity sell-off and mounting worries over US interest rates.
why: Bitcoin acts as a primary liquidity barometer in crypto markets, sensitive to shifts in global macro liquidity and risk appetite.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Broader tech stock weakness and expectations of sustained tight monetary policy prompted risk reallocations away from crypto.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bitcoin fell as investment funds trimmed holdings in higher-beta risk assets amid equity declines and elevated US interest rate projections.
